Dear ACENSI team,

I am writing to apply for the Content Migration Specialist position in Brussels. With my hands-on experience in content management, CMS platforms, and web publishing, I am confident I can support your client's website migration and launch.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage content in WordPress, structure pages, and ensure SEO best practices. I have also built and maintained client websites, which gave me a strong eye for detail and consistency. My project mirook.com involved implementing structured data and metadata, which aligns with the need for correct tagging and page structure.

I am organized, pragmatic, and comfortable coordinating with stakeholders to meet deadlines. I work well in team settings and can communicate effectively in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 and improving. I am available to work on site in Brussels.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to your team. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
